**Risk flags:**

- Low interest coverage –2.1812 in 2024  
- Negative operating cash flow in 2024  
- Only 1 year(s) of financials available  

**Overview:** Prima Global Builders Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited construction firm focused on office renovation and interior works, incorporated on 29 Oct 2023 in Selangor. The company has a paid‑up share capital of RM 1,000,000, four directors and a top shareholder holding 49.22% of equity, with no corporate shareholders. Financially, 2024 revenue was RM 4,156,184, but the firm posted a net loss of RM 199,449, total liabilities of RM 2,062,406 against equity of RM 1,570,812, and an unqualified audit opinion.
